title: Hyundai owner's manual (US, 2025, code NE1a): Setting Electric Vehicle Specialized Functions (Battery Conditioning)
notes: Same wording as the 2026 page: manual Active option under EV > Battery Conditioning, and automatic conditioning that considers arrival time when a DC charger is set as destination or waypoint. The page does not name a model or year; the NE1 code is the IONIQ 5 platform code (inference).
